releases.notes:
New: The next sweep shows what's left to go after claims, in one line under the amount to go.
New: Sweep settings & balances lists what can be claimed: empty ATAs, cashback and wSOL above the kept minimum.
Improved: Overview shows win rate, trades, volume and costs below Strategies.
Improved: What's new lists each change on its own line.
Removed: The "Your landlord is jealous" payout headline.

Improved: Overview shows win rate, trades, volume and costs below Strategies.
New: The next sweep shows what's left to go once the empty ATAs, cashback and wSOL above the kept minimum are claimed.

New: Tapping a loss guard trade opens it in GMGN.
New: Loss guard trades can be sorted oldest, newest, biggest loss or smallest loss.
New: Admins can re-enable a stopped strategy from the bottom of the loss guard page.
New: Sweep details show your own split: SOL sent, USDC received and SOL converted.

New: Tapping a loss guard trade opens it in GMGN.
New: Loss guard trades can be sorted oldest, newest, biggest loss or smallest loss.
New: Admins can re-enable a stopped strategy from the bottom of the loss guard page.

New: Trading and loss guard rows show each coin's short address (first and last four), as on the web.
New: A coin traded more than once has the same colour on all its rows.
New: Each loss guard trade shows how much it bought, to check against the guard's minimum buy.
New: Settings → What's new lists every update.
Fixed: Figures shown right after a sell, sweep or bot command could be out of date.
Fixed: Overview's Net PnL now includes failed transaction costs not tied to a strategy, matching Trading and the web.

Improved: Pulling to refresh updates all four tabs at once.
Improved: Fewer requests to the server: identical reads are shared and Payouts no longer re-downloads its history.

Improved: Pulling to refresh on any tab updates every tab, so the wallet, next sweep and PnL match.
Improved: Tabs refresh when you come back to the app.

Improved: Every phone shows the same headline for a given sweep.
Improved: A headline doesn't repeat until all of them have been used.
Improved: Loss guard trades are listed in order, with a running total of the loss.
Improved: Sweep alert headlines don't repeat until all have been used, and never twice in a row.

Fixed: Calendar days no longer add yesterday's PnL to today.
Fixed: The daily report alert always includes the day's figures.
Fixed: Best and toughest hour show the right hour.

Fixed: The loss guard card lists only the trades the guard counted.
Improved: Cleaner peak label on charts.

New: Charts show a dashed line at the peak, as on the web.
Improved: The % stays visible while scrubbing a chart.
New: A strategy's chart can open any dates, including Yesterday.
New: Trades show each token's picture.

Fixed: The open trades' SOL value on Trading now updates as trades open and close.

New: Expenses section on Payouts, with upcoming monthly bills.
New: Investors see the SOL price.
Fixed: The chart no longer shows empty.
Improved: The Live dot is steadier.
Fixed: "Expenses unavailable": Expenses now reads card payments.
